title: TELOS
author: irpina
description: Mods kept on the Digitone mk1 itself (OS 1.43 and 1.44, core-dn1 5.0 or newer): a 2 MB store in the +Drive's raw sectors holds .elemod files, and at every boot TELOS links the ones switched on into the +Drive mods' area, with no new firmware. SETTINGS > MODS (TELOS) lists them: YES switches one on or off, APPLY & RESTART links the new set. A crash guard skips the mods once after a boot that didn't get 10 s in. tools/telos.py puts mods in the store, over USB MIDI SysEx on a unit (python tools/telos.py unit ...) or in a card image.
